text:
AT&T Stadium dị na Arlington, Texas, obodo nwere ihe dị ka 390,000 nke dị n’etiti Dallas na Fort Worth. E tinyere Arlington n’ọrụ na 1884, ebe obodo isi nke metroplex, Dallas, malitere na 1841. Ha abụọ na-etolite etiti Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex, otu n’ime mpaghara obodo kachasị ukwu na United States nwere ihe karịrị nde mmadụ 7.

Arlington abụrụla ebe egwuregwu na ntụrụndụ nke metroplex. N’akụkụ AT&T Stadium, obodo ahụ nwere Globe Life Field nke Texas Rangers na Six Flags Over Texas, na-achịkọta ụfọdụ ihe nkiri kachasị ama nke mpaghara ahụ n’otu mpaghara suburban.

Omenala bọọlụ ebe a abụghị nke suburban Arlington kama nke Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex sara mbara. Mpaghara ahụ nwere otu MLS FC Dallas, nke dị na Frisco, ma nwee nnukwu obodo Hispanic na Latin America na-eto eto nke nkwado ha na-eme ka ndị otu mba Mexico na South America nwee ndị na-eso ụzọ siri ike. Ọchịchọ a maka egwuregwu mba ụwa emewo AT&T Stadium ka ọ bụrụ ebe obere na-anabata: ụlọ egwuregwu ahụ emeela egwuregwu Concacaf Gold Cup ugboro ugboro na egwuregwu 2024 Copa América, na-adọta nnukwu ìgwè mmadụ mgbe niile ma na-eme ka metroplex nwee ọnọdụ na maapụ bọọlụ kọntinent.
